Proyecto\n\n**EDGE Quantum Guard** es un protocolo de **gobernanza** y un algoritmo de **estabilidad cuántica** que optimiza hardware cuantico por software.\n\nRoles del sistema (todos presentes en este notebook):\n\n| Rol | Nombre | Funcion |\n|-----|--------|--------|\n| Ojos | EDGE Observer / membrana AOM | Observa friccion, regimen, proxy de coherencia |\n| Reflejos | MORPH / Layout Guard | Elige layout de qubits (MIS) |\n| Juicio | Multi-sistema / gobernanza | Plan de minima accion + veredicto causal |\n| Manos | Centinela / DD condicional | Ejecuta intervencion y la carga de trabajo |\n\n## 2. Objetivo de validacion\n\nDemostrar que el **mismo flujo de trabajo** (QSVM) mantiene **mejor estabilidad durante la corrida** cuando EQG esta activo, frente al mismo flujo **sin EQG**.\n\nNo se valida un modulo aislado. Se valida **EQG completo** operando en la ejecucion.\n\n```text\nArm B (EQG ON):  Ojos -> Reflejos -> Juicio -> Manos + QSVM en lotes\n                 probes entre lotes -> intervencion si hace falta -> Juicio causal\n\nArm A (EQG OFF): mismo QSVM en lotes, mismos probes, sin plan ni DD ni remap\n```\n\n## 3. Metodologia pre-registrada\n\n| Parametro | Valor |\n|-----------|--------|\n| Carga | QSVM kernel ZZFeatureMap, 2 qubits |\n| Lotes de trabajo | 3 |\n| Probes de estabilidad | 4 (t0 + tras cada lote) |\n| Shots | 64 trabajo / 64 probe |\n| Cuenta maxima | Arm B <= 20 s, Arm A <= 20 s (total <= 40 s) |\n| Gate Arm A | Solo si Arm B completo y dentro de presupuesto |\n| Metrica principal | Serie temporal de proxy de coherencia; drop y slope |\n| Exito | Arm B degrada menos que Arm A (drop/slope) |\n\n**Cola no es cuenta.**\n\n## 4. Criterios de aceptacion\n\n| ID | Criterio |\n|----|----------|\n| C1 | Ciclo B ejecuta Ojos, Reflejos, Juicio, Manos, QSVM, probes, Juicio causal |\n| C2 | Cuenta B <= 20 s |\n| C3 | Serie proxy[t] registrada en B y A |\n| C4 | Layout B = MORPH; layout A = ingenuo |\n| C5 | Veredicto temporal: B degrada menos que A, o se documenta ausencia de distincion self.cap = capacity\n        self.lo, self.hi = lo, hi\n        self.regime = LayoutRegime.ESTABLE\n\n    def push(self, friction: float):\n        self.buf.append(friction)\n        self.buf = self.buf[-self.cap:]\n        sm = friction if len(self.buf) == 1 else 0.6 * friction + 0.4 * (sum(self.buf[:-1]) / (len(self.buf) - 1))\n        r = self.regime\n        if r == LayoutRegime.ESTABLE:\n            if sm >= 0.70: self.regime = LayoutRegime.CONFLICTO\n            elif sm >= self.hi: self.regime = LayoutRegime.INESTABLE\n        elif r == LayoutRegime.INESTABLE:\n            if sm < self.lo: self.regime = LayoutRegime.ESTABLE\n            elif sm >= 0.70: self.regime = LayoutRegime.CONFLICTO\n        else:\n            if sm < self.lo: self.regime = LayoutRegime.ESTABLE\n            elif sm < self.hi: self.regime = LayoutRegime.INESTABLE\n        return self.regime, sm\n\n\ndef props_health(backend, qs: Sequence[int]) -> Dict[int, QubitHealth]:\n    props = getattr(backend, \"properties\", lambda: None)()\n    out = {}\n    for q in qs:\n        h = 0.7\n        t2 = None\n        if props is not None:\n            try:\n                t1 = props.t1(q) or 50e-6\n                t2v = props.t2(q) or 40e-6\n                er = props.readout_error(q) or 0.05\n                s = (min(t1 / 1e-4, 1.5) * min(t2v / 8e-5, 1.5)) / estado=est.value)\n    return out\n\n\nclass Ojos:\n    def __init__(self):\n        self.membrane = AOMMembrane()\n        self.last = None\n\n    def observe_from_probe(self, backend_name, float(qh.health)\n            frics.append(f)\n            qdicts[q] = asdict(qh)\n        raw = float(np.mean(frics)) if frics else 1.0\n        if proxy_override is not None:\n            raw = 1.0 candidates=list(candidates),\n            qubits=qdicts, friction=raw, smoothed=sm, regime=regime.value,\n            best_qubit=best, n_estable=n_e, n_degradado=n_d, n_inestable=n_i,\n            health_mean=float(np.mean([probe_map[q].health for q in candidates if q in probe_map] or [0.5])),\n        )\n        self.last = lh\n        return lh\n\nprint(\"Ojos edges = [(i, i + 1) for i in range(n - 1)]\n    return edges\n\n\nclass Reflejos:\n    def select_connected(self, health: LayoutHealth, edges, k: int):\n        \"\"\"Mejor camino fisico conectado de k qubits (el QSVM necesita CZ entre vecinos).\"\"\"\n        def sc(q): return float(health.qubits.get(q, {}).get(\"health\", 0.5))\n        ok = {q for q in health.candidates if health.qubits.get(q, best, best_s = None, -1.0\n        for a in sorted(ok):\n            for b in sorted(adj[a]):\n                path = [a, b]\n                while len(path) < k:\n                    nxt = [n for n in adj[path[-1]] if n not in path]\n                    if not nxt: break\n                    path.append(max(nxt, key=sc))\n                if len(path) >= k:\n                    s = k)\n            if sel:\n                return MorphLayout(event_id=health.event_id, selected=sel, score=s,\n                                   latency_ms=(time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000)\n        all_q = set(health.candidates)\n        for a, b in edges:\n            all_q.add(a); all_q.add(b)\n        def sc(q):\n            if q in health.qubits:\n                return float(health.qubits[q].get(\"health\", 0.5))\n            return 0.5\n        pool = sorted(all_q, key=lambda q: -sc(q))[: max(30, 8 * k)]\n        forbidden = {q for q in pool if health.qubits.get(q, {}).get(\"estado\") == \"inestable\"}\n        idx = {q: i for i, q in enumerate(pool)}\n        adj = [set() for _ in pool]\n        for a, b in edges:\n            if a in idx and b in idx:\n                adj[idx[a]].add(idx[b]); adj[idx[b]].add(idx[a])\n        n = len(pool)\n        rd = [len(a) for a in adj]\n        alive = [True] * n\n        w = [sc(q) for q in pool]\n        for i, q in enumerate(pool):\n            if q in forbidden:\n                alive[i] = False\n        heap = [(-w[v] / (rd[v] + 1), v) for v in range(n) if alive[v]]\n        heapq.heapify(heap)\n        S = []\n        while heap:\n            key, v = heapq.heappop(heap)\n            if not alive[v] or abs(-key - w[v] / (rd[v] + 1)) > 1e-12:\n                continue\n            S.append(v); alive[v] = False\n            for u in adj[v]:\n                if not alive[u]:\n                    continue\n                alive[u] = False\n                for x in adj[u]:\n                    if alive[x]:\n                        rd[x] -= 1\n                        heapq.heappush(heap, (-w[x] / (rd[x] + 1), x))\n        selected = sorted([pool[i] for i in S], key=lambda q: -sc(q))[:k]\n        if len(selected) < k:\n            for q in pool:\n                if q not in selected and q not in forbidden:\n                    selected.append(q)\n                if len(selected) >= k:\n                    break\n        if len(selected) < k:\n            for q in pool:\n                if q not in selected:\n                    selected.append(q)\n                if len(selected) >= k:\n                    break\n        score = float(np.mean([sc(q) for q in selected])) if selected else 0.0\n        return MorphLayout(event_id=health.event_id, selected=selected, score=score,\n                           latency_ms=(time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000)\n\nprint(\"Reflejos — plan minima accion + causal\n# ============================================================\nclass Juicio:\n    def planificar(self, health: LayoutHealth, morph: MorphLayout, proxy=None) -> InterventionPlan:\n        options = []\n        g0 = 0.55 if (health.regime == \"ESTABLE\" and health.n_estable > 0 and health.n_inestable == 0) else 0.0\n        if proxy is not None and proxy < HEALTH_THR:\n            g0 = 0.0\n        options.append({\"tipo\": IntervencionTipo.NINGUNA, \"cost\": 0.0, \"gain\": g0,\n                        \"reason\": \"regimen estable; no intervenir\" if g0 > 0 else \"no intervenir\"})\n        options.append({\"tipo\": IntervencionTipo.FASE_VIRTUAL, \"cost\": 0.05, \"gain\": 0.15,\n                        \"reason\": \"fase preventiva\", \"phase\": {q: 0.0 for q in morph.selected}})\n        need_dd = (health.n_degradado + health.n_inestable > 0 or health.health_mean < HEALTH_THR\n                   or (proxy is not None and proxy < HEALTH_THR))\n        if need_dd:\n            options.append({\"tipo\": IntervencionTipo.DD_CONDICIONAL, \"cost\": 0.25, \"gain\": 0.55,\n                            \"reason\": \"DD condicional por salud/proxy\"})\n        if morph.score > 0.3 and health.regime != \"ESTABLE\":\n            options.append({\"tipo\": IntervencionTipo.REMAP_MORPH, \"cost\": 0.40, \"gain\": min(0.9, morph.score),\n                            \"reason\": \"remap MORPH\", \"morph\": asdict(morph)})\n        if health.regime == \"CONFLICTO\" and health.n_estable == 0:\n            options.append({\"tipo\": IntervencionTipo.ABORTAR, \"cost\": 0.0, \"gain\": 0.1, \"reason\": \"CONFLICTO\"})\n        elig = [o for o in options if o[\"gain\"] >= TARGET_INTEGRITY]\n        chosen = min(elig, key=lambda o: o[\"cost\"]) if elig else max(options, key=lambda o: o[\"gain\"] / max(o[\"cost\"], 0.01))\n        tipo = chosen[\"tipo\"]\n        targets = list(morph.selected)\n        return InterventionPlan(\n            event_id=health.event_id, tipo=tipo.value, target_qubits=targets,\n            activate_dd=(tipo == IntervencionTipo.DD_CONDICIONAL),\n            phase=chosen.get(\"phase\", {}), reason=chosen[\"reason\"],\n            expected_gain=chosen[\"gain\"], cost=chosen[\"cost\"], morph=chosen.get(\"morph\"),\n        )\n\n    def evaluar(self, plan, before: LayoutHealth, after: LayoutHealth) -> CausalVerdict:\n        df = before.smoothed - after.smoothed\n        dh = after.health_mean - before.health_mean\n        if dh > 0.03 or df > 0.03:\n            return CausalVerdict(plan.event_id, df, True, \"causa_directa\", True, \"Mejora medible de estabilidad.\")\n        if plan.tipo == \"ninguna\" and before.regime == \"ESTABLE\":\n            return CausalVerdict(plan.event_id, df, True, \"nulo\", True, \"Correcto no intervenir.\")\n        return CausalVerdict(plan.event_id, df, False, \"nulo\", False, \"Sin mejora medible.\")\n\nprint(\"Juicio OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-10T15:54:54.981361Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-10T15:54:54.981717Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-10T15:54:55.010007Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-10T15:54:54.981682Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-10T15:54:55.009141Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Juicio DD real (CPMG/XY4) + probe Ramsey en cuadratura\n# ============================================================\nfrom qiskit.circuit.library import XGate, YGate\nfrom qiskit.transpiler import PassManager\nfrom qiskit.transpiler.passes import ALAPScheduleAnalysis, PadDynamicalDecoupling\n\ndef resolve_dd_sequence(backend, name):\n    \"\"\"Devuelve (nombre_efectivo, [gates]). XY4 solo si 'y' es nativo en el target.\"\"\"\n    if name == \"XY4\":\n        ops = getattr(getattr(backend, \"target\", None), \"operation_names\", [])\n        if \"y\" in ops:\n            return \"XY4\", [XGate(), YGate(), XGate(), YGate()]\n        print(\"[DD] XY4 no nativo en %s -> uso CPMG\" % getattr(backend, \"name\", backend))\n    return \"CPMG\", [XGate(), XGate()]\n\ndef _count_dd(tc):\n    ops = tc.count_ops()\n    return int(ops.get(\"x\", 0) + ops.get(\"y\", 0))\n\ndef apply_dd(tcs, backend, qubits, name=DD_SEQUENCE):\n    \"\"\"Inserta DD en las ventanas ociosas de circuitos YA transpilados al layout fisico.\n    Devuelve (circuitos, n_pulsos_insertados, nombre_efectivo).\"\"\"\n    eff, seq = resolve_dd_sequence(backend, name)\n    target = backend.target\n    pm = PassManager([\n        ALAPScheduleAnalysis(target=target),\n        PadDynamicalDecoupling(\n            target=target, dd_sequence=seq, qubits=[int(q) for q in qubits],\n            pulse_alignment=getattr(target, \"pulse_alignment\", 1), skip_reset_qubits=False),\n    ])\n    out, added = [], 0\n    for tc in tcs:\n        try:\n            tc2 = pm.run(tc)\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(\"[DD] ERROR al insertar DD (%s) -> circuito sin DD\" % e)\n            tc2 = tc\n        added += _count_dd(tc2) - _count_dd(tc)\n        out.append(tc2)\n    return out, added, eff\n\ndef probe_delay(backend, us=PROBE_DELAY_US):\n    dt = getattr(backend, \"dt\", None)\n    if not dt:\n        return float(us), \"us\"\n    g = int(getattr(getattr(backend, \"target\", None), \"granularity\", 16) or 16)\n    n = max(g, int(round(us * 1e-6 / dt / g)) * g)\n    return n, \"dt\"\n\ndef probe_qcs(n, delay, unit):\n    \"\"\"Ramsey en dos cuadraturas (X, Y) con espera libre constante.\"\"\"\n    out = []\n    for basis in (\"X\", \"Y\"):\n        qc = QuantumCircuit(n, n)\n        for i in range(n): qc.h(i)\n        qc.barrier()\n        for i in range(n): qc.delay(delay, i, unit=unit)\n        qc.barrier()\n        for i in range(n):\n            if basis == \"Y\": qc.sdg(i)\n            qc.h(i)\n        qc.measure(range(n), range(n))\n        out.append(qc)\n    return out\n\ndef p0_bit(counts, bit):\n    tot = sum(counts.values()) or 1\n    z = 0\n    for k, v in counts.items():\n        s = str(k).replace(\" \", \"\")\n        if len(s) > bit and s[::-1][bit] == \"0\":\n            z += int(v)\n    return z / tot\n\ndef coherence_proxy(cx, cy, n):\n    \"\"\"|rho01| medio sobre los qubits del layout, desde cuadraturas X e Y.\"\"\"\n
